name: Narrata
description: Reads web pages aloud with a natural voice that runs on your device, highlighting each word as it is spoken.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://huggingface.co https://*.huggingface.co https://*.hf.co https://api.github.com; default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; media-src 'self' blob:; worker-src 'self'
